gian_nidhi.abstract: In a transmission system, transmission of power from a rotating power source to a rotating load takes place. Conventional Transmission allows for the selection of discrete gear ratios,thus limiting the system to provide maximum power or efficiency for limited ranges of transmission output speed. A continuously variable transmission however is a type of transmission that allows An infinitely variable ratios change within a finite range, thereby allowing the system to continuously operate in its most efficient or highest performance range. Tthe mechanism works by moving the reinforced belt up and down the inverted cones during rotation to provide a changing set of gear ratios. The inverted cone shaped pulleys provide a large amount of gear ratios for smooth transmission which is important for the low end torque required fir initial tilling. When the motor is started , The motor pulleys drives the input shaft which in turn rotates the holder rings and the sprocket bars engaged in the holder rings. The sprocket bars engaged in the teeth of the transmission belt give motion to the transmission belt . The transmission belt is guided in the rollers mounted on the speed change nut. The belt Teeth engaged in the sprocket bars of the output cone shaft drive the sprocket bars and thereby the holder rings and the output shaft.

gian_nidhi.abstract: IN manufacturing industry, portable CNC milling machine is important to produce a product. This project describes design and fabrication of portable CNC milling machine. This project utilized operating principles of CNC milling machine where it can move in 3 axes specifically X,Y,Z. For this project Master CAM software was used to generate the G-code for milling cutting construction testing. The most important part is the holder of the spindle, without a strong spindle holder it is difficult to produce good quality products. This project develop CNC machine in combination with the computer. Parallel port was utilized together with intermediate Mach3 software to move the machine during cutting process . The purpose of this project is to develop a low-cost project portable CNC milling machine. It can be transported using minimum manpower, easily handled and also suitable for small industry . AC power supply is used to sent to the noise filter to reduce signal interference before sent to the stepper motor to allow axes X,Y,Z move .CNC machine structure movement is controlled by the DC steeper motor. For example, when DC steeper motor gets signal ,it was sentr to the gear box and turn the ball screw that connect with each drivers X,Y,Z moving to start cutting process according to the computer instruction until the cutting done.

gian_nidhi.participants: Suryawanshi Jaydeep Bhimrao.
gian_nidhi.abstract: Personal mobility means freedom for the physically challenged. One of the best inventions in the medical field that helped both the elderly and the handicapped is the mobility vehicle. The fact that they are no longer depending on some one else topper form daily duties is a big step forward. A large variety of mobility vehicle are available, from which one is to be selected as per requirements. Mobility vehicles are designed based on the usage i.e. either indoor or outdoor. They make use of conventional energy for recharging . The cost of the require considerable use and control of both arms for operation, thus adaptations are required for individual with asymmetrical use of their arms. Building kupon previous projects ,the goal of this project is to create accessory ,to be installed on a standard wheel chair, which would allow full control of the wheel chair with only one hand while addressing areas lacking in commercial products and previous designs, such as manufacture ability, attendant control user comfort and ergonomics. After preliminary testing and analysis of three arm propulsion designs, the project team developed a design for a removable ,lever operated accessory which could be adapted to fit a range of the most popular standard wheelchair models. The propulsion system, connected to the main lever by a coupler link ,consists a dual gear-pawl assembly in which the desired direction of motion is chosen by moving a shifter to engage one of the two gears press-fit around clutches, each of hich allows motion in only one direction, either forward or reverse . By including a neutral pawl position in which neither clutch is engaged, this design allows at attendant to propel and control the chair .In this paper an attempt is made to fabricate a steering powered wheel chair at an optimal cost which can be utilized both indoor and outdoor environments.

Generally if the car is in motion the converted sunlight is delivered directly to the Motor Controller, but there are times when there is more energy coming from the array then the Motor Controller needs, when this happens, the extra energy gets stored in the batteries for later use. When the solar array can’t produce enough energy to drive the motor at the desired speed the array energy is supplemented with stored energy from the batteries. Of course, when the car is not in motion, all the energy from the solar array is stored in the batteries. There is also a way to get back some of the energy used to propel the car, when the car is being slow down, instead of using the normal mechanical brakes, the motor is turned into a generated towards and turned into a generator and energy flow backwards through the Motor Controller and energy into the batteries for storage. This is known as Regenerative braking. The amount of energy returned to the batteries is small, but every bit helps.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Due to fuel crises and increasing pollution. There is a need of eco-friendly Vehicle. This lead to produce for bio-bike or to convert petrol bike into bio-gas bike with certain modification. Bio bike consist of four main component 1. Gas storage tank. 2. Regulation kit. 3. Filter. 4. Rubber tube 1. Gas storage tank:- it is simply a tank use to store gas and supply to engine. 2. Regulation kit:- it is a kit which regulate or to maintain the flow of gas continuous 3. Filter :- Filter is used for remove the moisture present in gas. 4. Rubber tube: Rubber tubes are used to connect the various devices to engine cylinder. Bio-Gas and petrol are 90% similar for supplying to engine cylinder. Only difference is that Bio- Gas is directly supply in combustion chamber and air is drawn from carburetor. As uses 4-stoke petrol engine so working is similar to 4-stroke engine. 1. Suction stroke: - When piston moves from T.D.C. to B.D.C. pressure is less in cylinder than that of atmosphere so vacuum is created inside the cylinder due to which air is suck from carburetor along with Bio-Gas is enter in combustion chamber. 2. Compression Stroke: - When piston moves from B.D.C. to T.D.C. it compressed the charge present in engine cylinder which rises the temperature and pressure of charge at the end of compression stroke spark will take place. 3. Expansion/power stroke: - In this stroke piston is moved from T.D.C. to B.D.C. due to burning of charge and work done on piston by gases it develops power hence, it is called power stroke. 4. Exhaust Stroke: After the end of power stroke piston moves from B.D.C. to T.D.C. it allows to escape the exhaust gases in to atmosphere through exhaust valve. Bio-Gas fuel is easily obtained from Bio-Gas plant. Its construction is very easy with low skill required e.g. 10 feet depth and 10 feet diameter. The amount required for construction is 10,000 to 15, 000. only the main advantage is that raw material is used for making gas is cattle dung, wastage food.

gian_nidhi.abstract: The Newton automatic centrifugal clutch employees only one set of compression springs instead of the usual two seats, with this arrangement it is possible to reduce the weights of the centrifugal members. When the clutch is disengaged & the engine is running at idling speed the hinged bob weights rest against the lower or inward sides of holes in the flywheel. When the engine is accelerated above 700 to 800 r.p.m. , the weights fly outwards and in doing so their leers ends compress the spring, so as to engage the clutch plate. When the full engagement pressure between the clutch member has been attain any further increase in engine speed brings the bob weights against the outsides of the flywheel holes, thus limiting the pressure plate action. The clutch withdrawal levers are of orthodox design so when clutch is operating of speeds above its centrifugal engagement speed the clutch can be disengaged or reengaged for gear changing purpose as in normal band gear change practice.

gian_nidhi.abstract: In early stages, a few towns used acetylene for lighting, including Tata in Hungary where it was installed on 24 th July 1897 & North Petherton in England in 1898. Now a days acetylene is used for carburization of steel acetylene lamp, fore cavers and mines, for gas welding and cutting, etc. Acetylene gas is also called as Ethyne and Ethine, was discovered in 1836 by Edmund Davy in England, who identified it as a “ New carburet of hydrogen” French Chemist Marcellin Berthelot, who coined the name “Acetylene”, rediscovered it in 1860. Now a day, the fuels used for S. I. engine are petrol, kerosene, C.N.G. and L.P.G., etc., which is likely to get exhausted in future and also the cost of the fuel is increasing day by day. It creates pollution; hence it is need of time to investigate an alternate fuel, which is suitable for S.I. engine. The alternative fuel should be easily available in market at low cost. Acetylene due to its good physical, chemical and thermodynamic properties would be used as an alternative fuel. Acetylene (C2H2) is not an air gas, but a synthesis gas; generally produce from the reaction of calcium carbide with water. It is colorless gas, has a strong garlic odor, unstable, unsaturated, and highly combustible and produces a very hot flame (over 3000 o C). Acetylene can solve all the problems like combustion, knocking. Thermal efficiency, and pollution. It is available at low cost (i.e. 1 kg of carbide gives 349 lit. of acetylene which is about only Rs. 30/- approx) Acetylene is used to run S.I. engine. gian_nidhi.participants: Sanket Vivek Phalak, Sagar Subhashrao Raut, Hemchandra Ashok Rane, Amol Shridhar Nagpure, Vinit Kashinath Kolte
gian_nidhi.abstract: Every automotive suspension has two goals: passenger comfort and vehicle control. Comfort is provided by isolating the vehicle’s passengers from road disturbances. Control is achieved by keeping the car body from rolling and pitching excessively, and maintaining good contact between the tire and the road. Unfortunately, these goals are in conflict. In a luxury sedan the suspension is usually designed with an emphasis on comfort, but the result is a vehicle that rolls and pitches while driving and during turning and braking. In sports cars, where the emphasis is on control, the suspension is designed to reduce roll and pitch. For this we are design this electromagnetic (EM) shock absorber. In this damper as the coil assembly moves, the fluid in the direction of travel is pressurized, and flows through the orifice, where it can be activated by the electromagnetic coils. Increasing field strength produces stronger MR particle chains between the two poles of the field, creating a higher resistance to the flow of the MR fluid through the orifice section of the piston. This resistance provides the proper dissipation of force and damps the vibrations properly. During this the accumulator balance the volume of fluid in cylinder (i.e. above the piston & below the piston) In this EM shock absorber we are use magneto-rheological fluid. The magneto-rheological fluid like electrorheological fluid is a king smart material whose rheological properties may be rapidly varied by the application of a magnetic field. This material typically consists of micron-sized ferrous particles dispersed in a fluid or an elastomer. When the MR fluid is exposed to a magnetic field, the liquid state may be changed to semi-liquid or extremely to a solid state. When the magnetic field is removed, the state may recover to liquid. The speed of rheology is an order of millisecond.

gian_nidhi.participants: Shrikant Purushottam Kulkarni, Rakesh Bhaskarrao Jagtap, Sanjay Ashok More, Sumeet B. Kunkari, Virendra Brijlal Lohar

Aiming to meet this emission and fuel consumption, regulation while contributing to the evolution of the vehicle oriented society and offering various solutions to vehicle fulfillment the better performance. Throttle body injection (TBI) system is very versatile highly adoptable form of electronic control fuel injection system. TBI provides the optimum mixture ratio of air-fuel at all stages of combustion. Throttle body injection system has immediate response characteristics to constantly changing condition and allows the engine to run with the leanest possible air fuel mixture ratio with greatly reducing exhaust gas emission. Because of its air-fuel mixture is so precise best upon much more than simple engine vacuum and other mechanical metering means. TBI naturally enjoys an increased in fuel economy over a simple mechanical form of fuel introduction such as outdated carburetor. The throttle body injection system is form of electronic fuel injection which is controlled by the ECM (electronic control module) which controls the throttle body injection system based on electronic fuel injection system through all stages of operation according to data received regarding the current state of engine performance, speed and load. Means ECM is the brain of throttle body injection system. Now a days the main objectives of an automobile industry is to give a better quality of product in low cost which gives the better relaxation to the common people. Throttle body injection is one of the most system which fulfill the above all things and due to this TBI has certain advantages over the other fuel systems like less fuel consumption, increase in efficiency of engine and reducing the pollution. It is used in the light commercial vehicle, passenger cars and recently in the two wheeler for the better performance. It is also used in Bharat Stage-II or Euro Norms-II and due to this TBI has a bright future in automobile industry.

gian_nidhi.project_name: DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT OF DYNAMIC VIBRATION ABSORBER
gian_nidhi.participants: Sagar Shrirant Shewale, Mahendra, Shrikant Baban Chinchkar, Pankaj Hanmantrao Mali
gian_nidhi.abstract: The concept of the vibration absorber using variable stiffness beam has two important requirements. 1. The two absorber beams should deform as a single beam in bending as a cantilever. Thus, the two beams should act as a top and bottom fiber of a cantilever and no movement should take place with respect to each other of these two fibers. 2. The opening/closing movement between the rods should be independent of the attached mass. Also, there should not be any relative motion between the beam and mass, when the machine is running. The weight of the absorber should be as low as possible. The resonant device used is a parallel beam combination with one common lumped mass at each end. A mechanical system has been used to change the distance between the parallel beams and hence the moment of area about the neutral axis and thus the natural frequencies. This shaft has right hand and left hand threads on the top and bottom portions. Accordingly two internally threaded (right and left hand) blocks have been mounted on the shaft’s top and bottom portions. Further, the sub assembly of the vibration absorber has been mounted on these two blocks. For one complete rotation of the gears, the total liner distance covered is twice the pitch of the thread.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Forming sheet metal cylinders is an important activity for which ”SHEET ROLLING MACHINE” is required. In its operation the sheet of metal to be formed is inserted from front of the machine and passes through the two front gripping rollers securing uniform pressure of rollers on material through pressure adjusting screw; so that sheet will ride through rolls freely. The sheet is passing through gripping rolls strikes the top or forming rolls, if adjusted properly it will form a circle. Raising or lowering of the adjustable forming roller will give different diameter of cylinder. Machine is power operated run by a motor that drives a worm gear box whose output shaft is connected to the gripping roller gear train. The pressure or forming roller is adjusted by means of pressure adjusting screws. Another feature is corporated in material is that of “BEEDING”. In beeding operations, an semicircular groove is formed on the sheet metal that gives strength and stiffness to the sheet metal component formed. For beeding operation the male and female beeding rollers are fitten on the gripping rollers on the other side of gear train and the sheet metal to be beeded passed through the two rollers.

Our goal is to develop biped humanoid robot that is capable of working stably in a human living and working space, with a focus on their physical construction and motion control. If the robot is having legs, it will find its own way out of avoiding or overcoming an obstruction and it can complete the desired task in an estimated time. At the first stage, we have to develop a human like biped robot, WABIMAN (Walking Biped Humanoid) which has ten mechanical degrees of freedom. Its weight is 1 kg here a moment compensation method is described for stability, which is based on a pattern switching technique. By a combination of both methods, the biped robot is able to perform dynamic stamping, walking forward and backward in continuous time. Using WABIMAN human follow walking experiments are conducted and effectiveness of the modes are verified. This paper introduces various applications. Thus it can be called as multipurpose robot. gian_nidhi.abstract: The Electrical stator winding machine is used for winding purpose. This machine consists of number of components. The machine is generally driven by electrical motor. This machine requires perfect setting of Stator before winding. It requires hours of human effort for its loading and unloading of Stator that is positioning the stator at exact location for each groove. This machine is power operated machine; hence it consumes much more electricity. As electric motor is used for running of whole unit, vibrations are generated. And there is great reduction in life of components due to vibrations. Also this machine has more cost. These machines are complicated in construction so maintenance cost is high. Accurate positioning of stator is time spending operation. So the attempt is made which eliminates all the difficulties and disadvantages. This device is applicable for both commercial and industrial fields. This is the manually operated stator winding machine. In this machine there are all the mechanical components so life of machine is longer. As this is manually operated machine, external source of power is totally eliminated. The time required for winding is also less. This device makes the winding at exact location in stator groove. There is no insertion of turns from outside; hence there is not any chance of loosening of wire turns in stator groove. This advantage makes the use of machine for Stator winding. The stator on which turns are prepared gives smooth working of fan. The cost of this device is less as compared to Electrical stator winding machine. The operation of counting the turns to be fitted in the grooves of stator can be eliminated by using digital electronic counter. For overcome difficulties in Electrical Stator winding machine i.e. setting of Stator, we use the Lead screw and screw jack mechanism.

gian_nidhi.participants: More Yogesh Sampat, Shirrsath Chetan Pandurang, Kothwade Bhushan
gian_nidhi.abstract: 'The name fixture is derived from the fact that it is always fastened to the machine in fixed osition'. As two operations are to be performed on a component at a same dimensions, that are drilling and boring. These two operations are performed on two different CNC machines of same centre heights ( 114.7mm). So, we develop two fixtures, one for drilling and one for boring, considering the specifications of machine as well as the specifications of component. While designing these fixtures the method of location and clamping is such that the idle time on machine is very minimum. We had made the arrangement of fixture for easy and quick loading and unloading of the component. In these fixtures there are no chances for the improper loading of component. The sufficient clearance is provided to hold the component easily and to pass out the swarf (fine chips). The fixture is sufficiently rigid to secure the preset accuracy of machining. There is very fine arrangement in fixture, so that removal of work piece is not obstructed by burr. Here the ejection of component is very easy. The fixture is very safe and convenient in use. Also we have to consider some parameters, which are not the part of the given drawing of the fixture. Sometimes some operations are critical one to perform the machining operation and critical to check the dimension with the measuring devices, at these situations we have to go for the operation, which are not the parts of fixture as far as drawing is concerned. While taking these type of decision of performing these unexpected operations, we have to take care that these operations will not affect the accuracy, function of fixture and the given parameters of the component with respect to fixture. The processes that are carried out on these fixtures while manufacturing are turning, milling, drilling, boring, tapping, heat treatment and grinding.

gian_nidhi.abstract: There are various types of cutter, which are used according to their requirement for the particular job. There are two types of abrasives. 1) Natural abrasive: The natural abrasives contains certain types of impurities which reduce the cutting abilities & create non-uniformities in abrasive wheel.These impurities not only make difficulty in cutting action but also create non- uniformity in the wheel 2) Artificial abrasive : The artificial abrasive are man made , manufactured abrasive.They are manufagtured electro chemically.The main groups of artificial abrasives are aluminum-oxide (Al203) & silicon carbide(SiC) Here in this project we are using an artificial abrasive, which is suitable for a cutting purpose. In natural abrasives there are non uniformities but the wheels made from artificial abrasives are though so there occurs no problems in cutting. As the abrasives cutters were designed to cut in angular motion , we have designed our abrasives cutters on sliding motion. In this there is base plate on which the sliding motor with abrasive cutter & the holding system in which we can hold the job in any angle is fitted. The sliding motion of the cutter will reduce the man effort for cutting the job that was not is not possible in the cutter which is designed such as abrasive cutter in the angular motion. Here we can hold our job & turn in any angle we required to cut longitudinally.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Tricycle Fitted With Windmill Reducing Effort Of Pedallers
gian_nidhi.participants: Vinayak Yeshwant, Vikas Narayan Landge, Nilesh Nivrutti
gian_nidhi.abstract: Today tricycle are being looked at as a popular and cheap form of transport. It does not require any fuel and therefore it is environmental friendly. The use of tricycle is now a very common features in villages, towns & cities to carry Gods, LPG Cylinders as well as Passangers. The conventional tricycles require more human effort it becomes very difficult for the pedallar to pull the tricycle on the steep. The effort of the pedallar are reduced with the help of this modified tricycle. In this project we have used wind energy to pull a tricycle having an additional attachment of vertical axis wind mill with Bevel gear to convert wind energy into mechanical movement of a tricycle. It consists two horizontal shaft front and rear shaft. On the front shaft which receives as a rotation from the wind mill through a pair of bevel gears. Sprocket is mounted on front shaft which transmit power to rear shaft by a chain driver. The another driver from pedals to rear shaft. The lever is attached to shaft of wind mill to engage or disengage gears by up and down motion. In conventional tricycle the riders pedaling effort are transmitted to rear wheel shaft through a Sprocket-chain drive and tricycle move forward. But in tricycle fitted with wind mill the rotation of wind mill is transmitted first to the front shaft through a pair of bevel gear enclosed in box and then to rear shaft through Sprocket-chain drive. in case of starting tricycle it is pedaled to give initial starting torque prior to transmitting the power from the wind mill. The lever pressed in downward direction then gear is engaged hence once tricycle gained momentum. The wind mill starts rotating due to displacement of air.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Magnetic Levitation train works on the principle of repulsion of magnets. Permanent Magnets having North and South poles are placed below the train, side by side in a row. Similarly, coils are placed in a row over the entire length of the track. The driver IC BA6435 gives the supply to the coils. The Hall ICs are placed between the coils at certain intervals. It senses the polarity of the magnet over it. When power is switched ON, the Hall ICs senses the polarity of the respective magnets of the train over them and provides the corresponding signal to the driver IC. Accordingly, the driver IC gives the control signal to the coils to create the same polarity of the magnetic field in the coils below the train so that the train is repelled and moves ahead. Now the next magnet of the train having an opposite polarity will come over the Hall IC. The Hall IC will detect this change and will give the corresponding feedback to the driver IC and the entire procedure repeats.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Reinforced cement concrete is one of the important component in the construction industry. Now a days the use of concrete increased very much. There is acute shortage of raw materials for its preparation. An alternate method of replacing the zone below the neutral axis with inert weightless substances like hollow pipe will not greatly affect the strength and stress characteristics of the beam. Also it will not affect the geometry and shape. In this studies on partial replacement of concrete below the neutral axis by creating hollow cavity. In this experiment attempt is being made to reduce weight and cost of the reinforced concrete structures by replacing the concrete below the neutral axis. However, in RC beams strength of concrete laying below the neutral axis is not fully utilized. So this un-utilized concrete is removed by placing a PVC pipe instead, hence making the beam hollow below the neutral axis. This is an alternative to reduce the use of concrete. The concrete just above neutral axis is less stressed whereas the concrete below the neutral axis serves as a shear transmitting media. The bond between PVC pipe and concrete layers at the pipe concrete interface should essentially be very good. It should be ensured that no slip will occur between the two layers. Experimental work is carried on the reinforced concrete beams with hollow cavity below neutral axis, So a cheap and light material can be used below the neutral axis. Sustainability can be achieved by replacing the partially used concrete. By saving concrete, we can save cement, which reduces the greenhouse gases emissions. So it is considered as environment friendly. Behavior of PVC pipe in filled reinforced concrete beams under 4 point flexure is find out experimentally and the results are compared with the conventional reinforced concrete beam and it is observed that saving of concrete is achieved.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Control of Hydraulic Jump using Hump and study Dissolved Oxygen in Jump
gian_nidhi.abstract: A hydraulic jump is a phenomenon which has extensively been studied in the field of hydraulic engineering due to its frequent occurrence in open channel flow such as rivers and spillways. Hydraulic jump is a transition of super-critical to sub-critical with considerable energy dissipation. It is the easiest way for mixing oxygen from environment into any fluvial system (water) without major cost and difficulty. Due to its numerous practical applications, hydraulic jump is an interesting topic that has caught the imagination of many researchers since 18th century to till today. The researchers had done laboratory experiments to develop empirical relations for universal applications, experimental study for characteristics of jump, location of jump and control of jump using weir and other different appurtenances. However to the author’s best knowledge no one had given any concluding remark to control the jump using abrupt rise in the bed of the open channel. This is the main motivation for the present study in which experimental investigations have been done to control the hydraulic jump by providing the abrupt rise (hump) at the bed of rectangular open channel (laboratory flume) and also improves the ‘Dissolved Oxygen (DO)’ content of the same fluvial system (water). To accomplish the aim, various types of humps were designed and fabricated based on the critical velocity analysis based on maximum discharge condition in laboratory flume

gian_nidhi.project_name: Water Resources Planning To Manage Future Risks To Aurangabad Shendra-Bidkin (DMIC) Water Supply Scheme
gian_nidhi.abstract: Managing water supplies in a changing climate is a growing challenge. The uncertainty associated with future rainfall, river flows, water quality and groundwater makes it difficult to plan for the future with any degree of certainty. Under the circumstances, it may be desirable to adopt flexible strategies that keep options open for the future. There is a desire to develop ‘adaptation pathways’ for water resources management systems. Adaptation pathways demonstrate the possible sequences of options that might be adopted to cope with a wide range of future conditions.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Assessment of Groundwater Quality for Potability in and around Waluj MIDC, District Aurangabad using GIS
gian_nidhi.abstract: Groundwater contamination is one of the significant problems in India. Aurangabad region is an example of an area where the groundwater is contaminated as a result of infiltration of waste water in river and streams adjacent to industrial area. Such contamination poses significant environmental threats for the surrounding environment and groundwater. There are three main sources of river and groundwater pollution in study area which includes domestic waste disposal activities, Industrial effluent disposal, leaks and non point source activities such as agricultural management practices Total generation of sewage in Aurangabad city is 107 MLD. Total quantity of industrial effluent generated from Waluj MIDC area is 10.72 MLD and total domestic effluent generated is 3.928 MLD. (Aurangabad MPCB report -2014). Therefore water quality monitoring is necessary in Aurangabad urban area, There are possibilities of leakage, seepages, spillages from very old ETPs. Aurangabad is one of the critically polluted industrial cluster identified by CPCB and its CEPI score is 77.44. This critically polluted industrial cluster needs further detailed study in terms of the extent of damage and formulation of appropriate remedial action plan. This study will examines the effect of anthropogenic contamination on the quality of groundwater particularly in Waluj MIDC area in Aurangabad City, Aurangabad is the fastest industrial developing city in Marathwada. In order to evaluate the quality of groundwater in study area, 350 bore-well water samples spread over an area 1520 hectares in Waluj MIDC of Aurangabad city are selected to analyze for drinking water quality standards to find out the level of pollutant and their responsible factors.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Policy Assessment Tool Of Rural Drinking Water Supply Schemes At Village Level
gian_nidhi.abstract: Water is the basic essential need of human life. However, whether the drinking water assessment is being properly carried out is a question of issue. According to survey and data studies it has been noted that drinking Water Security has become a challenge for the country, specifically in rural areas. With ever growing population, demand is bound to grow and in recent times climate change has aggravated the problem more. Recognizing the gravity of the situation and considering the “common pool resource” nature of water, governments havestepped in to ensure the drinking water security to their subjects. This has led to evolution of policies and several paradigms shifts in policy formulation. One of them is from ‘supply driven to demand driven’. But our own experience and stated by many others; suggests that there is always a huge gap between policy and implementation. This gap is mainly due to absence of regular Assessment, Evaluation and Monitoring in current practice.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Increasing the Coefficient of Performance is very essential due to energy crisis and there exists a vast scope in domestic refrigerator system. In this study a combination of air cooled and shell and coil heat exchanger for domestic refrigerator is studied numerically. For obtaining higher COP we have to cool down refrigerant below sub cooled region. This can be achieved by use of this heat exchanger to great extent. Designed heat exchanger permits large heat transfer by providing more heat transfer area. The objective of this project work to investigate numerically the effect of water-cooled condenser in a household refrigerator. The study will be done using HFC134a as the refrigerant and Polyol-ester oil (POE) oil as the lubricant. The performance of the household refrigerator with air-cooled and water-cooled condenser will be compared with the same set of conditions for both the set-ups numerically. The water cooled and air cooled condensers are designed on ANSYS workbench and subjected to the same pressure and temperature conditions. The results obtained from the study show increased COP, and efficient performance. Furthermore, the hot water obtained from water cooled condenser could be used for domestic purposes.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Pedal operated water pump will consist of a centrifugal pump operated by pedal power. The centrifugal pump is positioned on its stand in such a way that driven shaft of the centrifugal pump was welded to the bicycle sprocket . By pedaling the bicycle, the bicycle sprocket rotates, thereby rotating the centrifugal pump which in turns discharges water from the sump Pedal operated water pump provides lifting of water and irrigation in remote areas where electricity is not available. Pedal operated water pump is not only free from pollution but also provide healthy exercise. Pedal operated water pump reduces the rising energy costs. Pedal operated water pump will design as a portable one which can be use for irrigation in various place. Main aim of this work is to design, fabricate, investigate the working of pedal operated water pump (powp) which is used to lift water up to 20 feet to 30 feet height. Powp is used to lift water from sump to water tank in city when there is no electric power supply or load shedding. Powp main part is centrifugal pump which is operated by pedal power. The centrifugal pump is placed in such a way that driven shaft of the centrifugal pump is same shaft of pulley which is driven bicycle wheel. When pedaling is done, then bicycle wheel start rotating, so pulley will rotate and therefore rotating the centrifugal pump which will lift water from sump to 20 feet to 30 feet. Powp is used in irrigation in remote areas where there is no electricity. Using powp we can save energy and no pollution. Powp pump can used for exercise purpose also.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Recently, there has been a rapid growth in research and innovation in the natural fiber composite (NFC) area. Interest is warranted due to the advantages of these materials compared to others, such as synthetic fibre composites, including low environmental impact and low cost and support their potential across a wide range of applications. Much effort has gone into increasing their mechanical performance to extend the capabilities and applications of this group of materials. This review aims to provide an overview of the factors that affect the mechanical performance of NFCs and details achievements made with them and number of biological materials may be incorporated into polymer materials. In recent years, there has been a marked increase in interest in biodegradable bio-composite material for use in packaging, agriculture, medicine, and other areas. The belief is that polymer bio-composite materials will reduce the need for synthetic polymer production (thus reducing pollution) at a low cost, thereby producing a positive effect both environmentally and economically. This review is intended to provide a brief outline of work that is under way in the area of polymer biocomposite research and development, the scientific theory behind these materials, areas in which this research is being applied, and future work that awaits

gian_nidhi.abstract: Our project aims in implementing software that will help lecturers to take the attendance of students using mobile/Smartphone. Lecturer would just open the app and they will take attendance using mobile phone. After this the attendance records will be saved in the online server-based database. Lecturer will be able to retake attendance by taking the attendance again for the same day and overwrite previous one or just edit up the previously taken attendance. Will have functions to generate and store reports and view students detained according to till date attendance. These days’ lecturers in universities and colleges take the attendance manually either by calling out individual's name or by passing around an attendance sheet for student's signature to confirm his/her presence. Using these methods is both cumbersome and time-consuming. This project is based on Android/Java Technology. Teachers can login into their attendance account to access their databases. Teachers can add new Branches / Classes and Subjects and the students in the database. Teachers can take attendances on daily basis. Teachers can view any previously taken attendance of any date. Teachers can view statistical data i.e. they can view the statistics of attendance taken till date or between a selected date range. Teachers can also view the list of students detained till date or between a selected date range and can also export that list into a text file. Teacher also have option to generate reports which contain all the attendance data in table form i.e. into an excel report. The main aim behind making this project is to overcome the difficulties or disadvantages and difficulties faced in the current manual, register – based attendance system and make a small application to help teachers do all the attendance work efficiently and easy which will save the manual work needed in previous manual attendance system.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Power factor is ratio between the useful (true) power (kW to the total (apparent) power (kVA) consumed by an item of AC electrical equipment or a complete electrical installation. It is measure how efficiently electrical power is converted in useful work output. A poor power factor usually the result of a significant phase difference between the voltage & current power factor correction can be expressed in two ways. Power Factor (PF) = useful power (kW) divided by the total power (kVA) OR Power Factor (PF) = the cosine of the angle between the useful power & total power. CosO The power factor correction is achieved by addition capacitor in parallel with the load & can be applied at the equipment, distribution board or at origin of the installation. Static power factor correction it can be applied at each individual motor by connecting the correction capacitors to the motor starter. Static PFC must not be applied at the output of variable speed drive, solid state soft starter inverter as the capacitor can cause serious damage to electrical components.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Here is a controlling circuit, which enables switching “ON” & “OFF” appliances to telephone lines. It can be used to switch appliances from any distance, overcoming the limited range of infrared & radio remote controls. The circuit describe here can be used to switch up to 9 appliances. The DTMF signals on telephone instrument are used as control signals. The digit ‘0’ in DTMF mode is used to toggle between the appliance mode & normal telephone operation mode. Thus the telephone can be used to switch “ON”or “OFF” the appliances also while being used for normal conversation. The circuit uses IC CM 8870P (DTMF to BCD converter.) AS 746 (4 to 16 line demultiplexer) & five CD 4013 (D-flip) Ics Once a call is established the ring detector circuit detects the ring and places 220 loops across the telephone line by energizing relay 1 (RL1). After that dial any number (0 to 9) on the keyboard. For consideration supose key 1 is pressed IC (CM8870P) decodes this as 0001 which is further demultiplexed by IC 2 as o/p 01 (ATPIN 2) off IC s. AS746. This active low output of IC 2 after inversion by an inverter gate of IC 3 (CD4049) becomes logic 1. This pulse toggles the corresponding flip-flop to alternate state. The flip-flop output is used to drive a relay (RL2) which can switch ‘ON’ or ‘OFF’ the appliances connected through it’s contacts. The ring detector circuit is ‘on’ for some time after this the circuit is automatically switched off and removes the 220 ohms loop from telephone line. This is same as placing handset on the receiver. Therefore it cuts off the call and save the users money.

gian_nidhi.participants: Yashwant Deshmukh, Pratik Gohel, Mukund Motwani, Ankush Jangam
gian_nidhi.abstract: We are representing a stepper motor in which the direction of rotation of the stepper motor (in clockwise & anticlockwise direction) can be controlled remotely. The transmitter circuit, powered by a 6V battery, is built around timer NE555 (IC8), which is work as an astable multivibrator having a frequency of around 38 kHz. The frequency of the astable is decided by resistor R10, preset VR2 & capacitor C3. Preset VR2 is used to set the frequency to 38 kHz. The output of IC8 is fed to an infrared LED via current-limiting resistor R11. When switch S3 is pressed, the IR LED transmits 38 kHz modulated infrared signal. The transmitted 38 kHz modulated signal is received by infrared receiver module TSOP1738 (IC1) & it outputs a clock pulse to D-type flip CD4013 (IC2) via transistor T1. IC2 accepts date when its clock input is low & transfers it to the output on the positive-going edge of the clock. IC2 is configured as a toggle flip flop as its Q output is connected to ‘D’ input. Thus when TSOP 1738 receives a signal from the transmitter, it clocks IC2 & its Q output changes from high to low & vice versa on alternate clock inputs. Consequently, the state of Q output of IC2 controls the direction of the stepper motor. When Q output is high the stepper motor rotates in clockwise direction, & when Q output is low the stepper motor rotates in anticlockwise direction. The direction of rotation can also be controlled manually by setting Q output high or low with the help of switches S2 & S1, respectively.

gian_nidhi.abstract: The project is a kind of embedded system project. The 89c51 micro-controller is used in this system. The logic behind project is to interlace the IR receiver with the controller. The most of consumer electronics, from camcorders to stereo equipment, an infrared remote control is usually always included. Video and audio apparatus, computers and also lighting installations now days often operate on infra-red remote control. The carrier frequency of such infra-red signals is typically in the order of around 36 kHz. The control codes are sent in serial format modulated to that 36 kHz, carrier frequency (usually by turning the carrier on and off). There are many different coding system in use and generally different manufacturers use different code and different data rates for transmission “IR” stand for infrared light is invisible since its frequency is below that of visible red. Otherwise, it is like any other light source, operating under the same laws of physics. In most case, the IR signals are produced by an LED source. TV remotes send commands only one way, in a low- speed burst for distances of up to 30 feet. They use directed IR with LED’s that have a moderate cone angle to improve ease-of-use characteristics. The IR signal sent out by those devices is generally modulated to around 38 kHz carrier using amplitude shift keying. The data rate send is generally in range of 100-2000 bps. In this system generally RC5 encoding protocol is used in the transmitting section. On the receiver side a photodiode takes up the signal. The integrated circuit inside a typical receiving chip is sensitive only around a specific frequency in the 32-40 kHz range. The output is the demodulated digital input, the micro controller will sent output to one of its output pin of available 32-I/O pins. To these output pins various home equipments like Bulb, Tube-lights & Fans are interfaced using proper relays or driver circuitry. Some additional facilities such are variable speed control of D.C. Motor with the help of dimmer by incrementing / decrementing the count value in counters by one step.

gian_nidhi.abstract: The process of automatic toll collection at toll stations can be accomplished with the help of RFID technology. For automatic toll collection, the RFID tag is attached in the remote area of vehicle. This passive R/W (Read/Write) tag has in it stored all the unique details of the vehicle viz. the chassis no., engine no., registration no., etc. & the prepared amount with these R/W tags, one call write over existing information or add information to them. These tags usually have a serial no. that can’t be written over. It can thus be recharged by writing into the tag some amount of rupees using an RFID writer. RFID detectors are employed at toll stations, which are attached to the Microcontroller. These detectors continuously unit electromagnetic waves through air which activate the tag. When tag activates it transmits the data to the detector. The microcontroller checks for the validity & details of the vehicle. It deducts the prepaid amount on bases of the size of the vehicle (for which it is already programmed) & displays the balance amount on LED display. If vehicle is invalid, microcontroller closes the gate & activates the buzzer.

gian_nidhi.abstract: Working of this system is based on the transducers called Load cell. The strain gage is the heart of a load cell. A strain stage is the device that changes resistance when it is stressed. The gage are developed from an ultra-thin heat – treated metallic foil and are chemically bonded to a thin dielectric layer. Positioning of the gage, mounting procedure and materials used all have a measurable effect on performance of the load cell. Multiple strain gages are connected to create the four legs of a Wheatstone-bridge configuration. When an input voltage is applied to the bridge, the output becomes a voltage proportional to the force on the cell.

gian_nidhi.participants: Monali R. Dahapute, Prof. Amit Welekar
gian_nidhi.abstract: The goal of computer vision is to form, imitate, and to exceed human vision using computer software and hardware at different levels. This has brought great development in the agriculture field and fruit industries for recognizing fruits from its background images for various purposes like grading, defect recognition. In this paper a computer vision based system is studied for image segmentation of various Irregular shaped fruit images (e.g. Banana, papaya , mango, guava etc) captured under three illumination condition i.e. low, medium and high intensity. Study and discussion is carried out to enhance knowledge about irregular fruit image segmentation techniques, limitation and an enhancement to overcome previous limitation is studied. Each paper had considered images of only one kind of fruit for segmentation (i.e. apple, papaya and jatropa etc.), that may be individual one for defect segmentation or in a bunch for Fruit detection and counting (bananas and tomatoes). The segmentation task is difficult for isolating the images that captured in outdoor environment. There are many enhanced segmentation methods that have been developed over the past years, for fruit images which taken under natural illumination. These methods are sensitive to the variation of colour intensity which influenced by the sunlight illumination. This condition leads to low quality segmented images and therefore reduces the accuracy of object classification. A ruled based segmentation had limitation on images of non-circular shaped object with various colours. So Hybrid Segmentation Approach For Irregular Shape Fruit Images Under Natural Illumination will help to work for segmentation on Non Circular shaped fruits of various colours. New algorithm is generated to segment Irregular Shape Fruit Images under Natural Illumination. This algorithm will be using the combination of Improved Thresholding and Adaptive K-means with some modifications.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Analysis of Image Feature Selection Using Group Structure
gian_nidhi.participants: Namrata Naik, Prof. Jayant Rohankar
gian_nidhi.abstract: The global feature space has be achieved in advance . In real world applications, the features are actually generated dynamically. To induce the original high quality image from the degraded image is the fundamental principle of image restoration. Thus, it is necessary to perform feature selection by their arrival, which is referred to as online feature selection. The main advantage of online feature selection is its time efficiency and suitable for online applications, therefore, it has emerged as an important topic. Online feature selection assumes that features flow into the model one by one dynamically. The feature selection is performed by the arrival of features. The group information can be considered as a type of prior knowledge on the connection of the features, and it is difficult to be discovered from merely data and labels. Therefore, performing selection on feature groups can perform better than perform selection on features individually. Therefore, we first formulate the problem as online group feature selection. There are two challenges for this problem: 1) the features are generated dynamically; 2) they are with group structure. To the best of our knowledge. We propose a novel criterion based on spectral analysis. The criterion is proven to be efficient in the online intra-group feature selection.

gian_nidhi.abstract: There is no question that a two stroke internal combustion engine is infinitely simpler to manufacture, has less moving parts & it’s principle of operation is less complicated than a four stroke internal combustion engine of equal power. A two stroke engine is timed so that the rotary crankshaft valve hole is opening when the position is going up & creating a negative suction pressure, which drows in air fuel mixture during the compression at top dead center (B.D.C.) creating a positive pressure in the crankshaft. gian_nidhi.project_name: Rotating Solar Collector As A Steam Genrator.
gian_nidhi.participants: Pratik Mehta, Swapnil Borgaonkar, Ajaykumar Ray, Kirti Godbole
gian_nidhi.abstract: Rotating solar collectors are a new type of solar collector. The boiler consists of two concentric tubes. The inner tube absorbs sunlight and boils water. Thi stube is called the absorber. The outer transparent tube is filled with air and called the cover. The cover is made from transparent plastic. The empty space created between the absorber and cover is called the air layer. The end caps are used to support the cover and insulate the absorber tube. The motor is used to rotate the boiler and the reflexors are used to maximize the sun rays incident on the absorber. The air between the cover and the absorber rotates with the same rotational speed as the cover and the absorber. This causes a centrifugal acceleration to act on the air layer. The effect prevents convection completely when the centrifugal acceleration is greater than the gravitational acceleration. The operation temperature (100 o C) could not be established without the reflectors. Several important conclusions can be drawn from the experiments 1. Rotation prevents convection in the air layer. 2. The electrical power consumption is not prohibative. 3. Overall efficiency is around 46%. 4. The boiler has enough potential to justify further investigation. Economical analyses were performed as well. These analyses showed that any solar boiler should be very lightweight in order to reduce material cost. gian_nidhi.abstract: In applications like power stations & continuous process plants, a protection system is used to trip a faulty system to prevent damages & ensure the overall safety of the personnel & machinery. But this often results in multiple or cascade tripping of a number of sub-units. Looking at the tripped units does not reveal the cause of failure. It is therefore very important to determine the sequence of events that have occurred in order to exactly trace out the cause of failure & revive the system with minimal loss of time. The project that we have made stores the tripping sequence in a system with upto eight units/blocks. It uses an auxiliary relay contact point in each unit that closes whenever tripping of the corresponding unit occurs. Such contact points can be identified easily, especially in systems using Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs). This circuit records tripping of up to eight blocks & displays the order in which they tripped.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Error Detection in Majority Logic Decoding of Euclidean Geometry Low Density Parity Check (EG-LDPC) Codes.
gian_nidhi.participants: Ms. Sana Sheikh
gian_nidhi.abstract: Error detection in memory applications was proposed to accelerate the majority logic decoding of difference set low density parity check codes. This is useful as majority logic decoding can be implemented serially with simple hardware but requires a large decoding time. For memory applications, this increases the memory access time. The method detects whether a word has errors in the first iterations of majority logic decoding, and when there are no errors the decoding ends without completing the rest of the iterations. Since most words in a memory will be error free, the average decoding time is greatly reduced. In this brief, the application of a similar technique to a class of Euclidean geometry low density parity check (EG-LDPC) codes that are one step majority logic decodable. Extensive simulation results are given to accurately estimate the probability of error detection for different code sizes and numbers of errors.

gian_nidhi.project_name: Robust Face Recognisation Using Largest Matching Area for Illumination and Occlusion
gian_nidhi.participants: Ms.Akshata Bansod,
gian_nidhi.abstract: While there has been an enormous amount of research on face recognition under pose/illumination/expression changes and image degradations, problems caused by occlusions attracted relatively less attention. Facial occlusions, due, for example, to sunglasses, hat/cap, scarf, and beard, can significantly deteriorate performances of face recognition systems in uncontrolled environments such as video surveillance. The goal of this paper is to explore face recognition in the presence of partial occlusions, with emphasis on real-world scenarios (e.g., sunglasses and scarf). In this paper, we propose an efficient approach which consists of first analysing the presence of potential occlusion on a face and then conducting face recognition on the nonoccluded facial regions based on selective local Gabor binary patterns. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art works including KLD-LGBPHS, S-LNMF, OA-LBP, and RSC. Furthermore, performances of the proposed approach are evaluated under illumination and extreme facial expression changes provide also significant results.

gian_nidhi.project_name: To Combining Left and Right Palmprint Images for More Accurate Personal Identi?cation
gian_nidhi.participants: Ms. Sarika Pimple,
gian_nidhi.abstract: Multibiometrics can provide higher identi?cation accuracy than single biometrics, so it is more suitable for some real-world personal identi?cation applications that need high-standard security. Among various biometrics technologies, palmprint identi?cation has received much attention because of its good performance. Combining the left and right palmprint images to perform multibiometrics is easy to implement and can obtain better results. However, previous studies did not explore this issue in depth. In this paper, we proposed a novel framework to perform multibiometrics by comprehensively combining the left and right palmprint images. This framework integrated three kinds of scores generated from the left and right palmprint images to perform matching score-level fusion. The ?rst two kinds of scores were, respectively, generated from the left and right palmprint images and can be obtained by any palmprint identi?cation method, whereas the third kind of score was obtained using a specialized algorithm proposed in this paper. As the proposed algorithm carefully takes the nature of the left and right palmprint images into account, it can properly exploit the similarity of the left and right palmprints of the same subject. Moreover, the proposed weighted fusion scheme allowed perfect identi?cation performance to be obtained in comparison with previous palmprint identi?cation methods.

gian_nidhi.project_name: A Methodology For Extracting Standing Human Bodies From Single Images Using Multi Segmentation
gian_nidhi.participants: Ms. Avanti Pawar
gian_nidhi.abstract: Extraction of the human body in unconstrained still images is challenging due to several factors, including shading, image noise, occlusions, background clutter, the high degree of human body deformability, and the unrestricted positions due to in and out of the image plane rotations. Knowledge about the human body region can benefit various tasks, such as determination of the human layout, recognition of actions from static images, and sign language recognition. Human body segmentation and silhouette extraction have been a common practice when videos are available in controlled environments, where background information is available, and motion can aid the segmentation through background subtraction. In static images, however, there are no such cues, and the problem of silhouette extraction is much more challenging, especially when we are considering complex cases Moreover, methodologies that are able to work at a frame level can also work for sequences of frames, and facilitate existing methods for action recognition based on silhouette features and body skeletonization.

gian_nidhi.project_name: IMPROVING THE POWER SYSTEM PERFORMANCE USING FACTS DEVICES WITH HARDWARE APPROACH
gian_nidhi.participants: Pranjali R. Nirvikar
gian_nidhi.abstract: Abstract: The project entails simulating a model of a complete FACTS controller using STATCOM device. FACTS devices like STATCOM, it is designed based on voltage source converter (VSC) electronic device with gate turn off thyristor and dc capacitor coupled with step down transformer tied to a transmission line. The complete model either converts ac power into dc power by VSC as a control rectifier or convert the dc power into ac power by VSC as a PWM converter, during the time of transient faults especially when there is any change in reactive power. STATCOM provide controlled VAr compensator for grid voltage support. STATCOM can be designed to also act as an active filter to absorb system harmonics. The main objective of power project is deals with the reactive power compensation that is when reactive power in the power system is decreased then STATCOM will inject the reactive power in the power system network and when surplus reactive power available in the power system is increased beyond some limits then STATCOM will absorb the reactive power. The capacitor will charged or discharged according to control logic applied to VSC in control rectifier mode or inverter mode as per the reactive power variation in the power system. For prevention of large fluctuation in dc due to variation in ac system voltage maintaining the direct voltage near the rated value and prevention of commutation failure in inverter, we use the PWM method for firing of the VSC

gian_nidhi.project_name: “UNDERGROUND CABLE FAULT DISTANCE LOCATOR WITH ALARM SYSTEM”
gian_nidhi.participants: Pushpak y. Paunikar
gian_nidhi.abstract: Due to the faults the cables get damage which affects the resistance in the cable. If it allowed to persist, this can lead to voltage breakdown. To locate the fault in the cable, the cable must tested for faults. This uses the simple concept of OHMs law. The current vary depending upon the length fault of the cable. This is assembled with a set of resistors representing cable length and fault creation is made by set of switches at every known kilometer (km). The fault occurring at which distance and which phase is displayed on a 16X2 LCD display which is interfaced with the microcontroller. The program is run into ROM of microcontroller. The power supply consists of a step down transformer which is 230/12V, which step down the voltage to 12V AC. This is converted into DC using a Bridge rectifier. The pulsating dc voltage is removed using a capacitive filter and it is then regulated to +5V using a voltage regulator LM7805 which is (+5V) required for the operation of the microcontroller and other components.

Our electronic mileage indicator will show the mileage in Km/lit on o display that will be obtained if the vehicle travels at a particular load and speed. In other terms suppose. if the Driver is driving the vehicle with a load say 120 kg at a certain speed on a tar road, our mileage Indicator will give how much km the vehicle will per litre of FueI. Thus the driver can know the optimized driving condition thereby saving fuel. The design of ”Low Cost intelligent Fuel Mileage Indicator in two wheelers” is intended to developing a low cost device that can actively display the fuel mileage of a motorbike and display it in real time onto a display, which is attached/placed on the dashboard of a vehicle along with other driver information system. A unique method and system has been devised for giving instantaneous mileage readings in real time during both driving conditions and idling conditions corresponding to the amount of fuel consumed and the distance travelled by the motorbike. This device can be added as an enhancement to existing motorbikes to which, works on carburetor and even on bikes with fuel injection technology.

gian_nidhi.project_name: WATER QUALITY MONITORING AND CONTROLLING OF FISHING AGRICULTURE
gian_nidhi.abstract: Demand for fish and the fish processed food is increasing, while the condition of fisheries is currently in stagnation condition, and even tended to decrease production in several regions in different area. Marine environmental degradation as a caused by global climate change, coupled with uncontrolled excessive exploitation decrease the production of marine fisheries. Therefore, alternative suppliers of fishery products are from aquaculture. However, due to a limited area and climatic conditions are not always supported. These are becoming inhibiting the development of aquaculture in most countries in the world, including different area. Therefore, we need a technology that is used to increase the production of this aquaculture for example by monitoring water quality for fish farming. Routinely monitored parameters of liquid quality are temperature, pH, turbidity, conductivity, dissolved oxygen (DO), chemical oxygen demand(COD), biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), ammonia nitrogen, nitrate, nitrite, phosphate, various metal ions and so on. The most common method to detect these parameters is to collect samples manually and then send them to laboratory for detecting and analyzing. This method wastes too much manpower and material resource, and has the limitations of the sample collecting, long-time analyzing the aging of experiment equipment and other issues. To prevent the fish water pollution, first we have to detect the pollutant. In earlier days, the water pollution was detected by chemical test or laboratory test by using this system the testing equipment will be in stationary and samples will be given to testing equipment. In order to increase the pervasiveness, testing equipment can be placed in the water and detection of pollution can be made remotely This project proposes a Sensor-Based Water Pollution Detection, which will detect the pollutant present in the water and senses pH, turbidity and DO, Hardness, conductivity, TDS will be kept in the water surface and the data captured by the sensor will be given to ATmega328 controller. In addition. Neutral water can improve fish productivity can be accessed every time and can be placed everywhere.

gian_nidhi.participants: Ashish Parmar, Monik Shah, Sameer Lotalikar
gian_nidhi.abstract: Magnetic Levitation train works on the principle of repulsion of magnets. Permanent Magnets having North and South poles are placed below the train, side by side in a row. Similarly, coils are placed in a row over the entire length of the track. The driver IC BA6435 gives the supply to the coils. The Hall ICs are placed between the coils at certain intervals. It senses the polarity of the magnet over it. When power is switched ON, the Hall ICs senses the polarity of the respective magnets of the train over them and provides the corresponding signal to the driver IC. Accordingly, the driver IC gives the control signal to the coils to create the same polarity of the magnetic field in the coils below the train so that the train is repelled and moves ahead. Now the next magnet of the train having an opposite polarity will come over the Hall IC. The Hall IC will detect this change and will give the corresponding feedback to the driver IC and the entire procedure repeats

gian_nidhi.participants: 2. CHAPANERIA VATSAL B. ,3. GOTAWALA HARSHIL D.,4. KHANTHARIYA NIKUNJ S.
gian_nidhi.abstract: Variable speed drives are gaining popularity as an efficient way to power industrial motors. They collect and compute a large number of signals, normally used for control and operation purposes (for example, current, torque, speed, frequency, power, flux, etc.). This data is available and can be used for diagnostic purposes. These signals can be analyzed for their spectral content, for monitoring the operating point, for examining cyclic processes, etc. On the down side, the format, quality and quantity of data is determined by the hardware. Further complication arises from the fact that variable speed drives change the output frequency to follow desired process parameters. Methods for circumventing these difficulties are presented along with actual results from various drive-powered processes. These results prove that a variable speed drive can be a valuable source of diagnostic data not only for the drive itself, but also for the entire driven process.

gian_nidhi.abstract: A geo-fence could be dynamically generated—as in a radius around a store or point location. Or a geo-fence can be a predefined set of boundaries, like school attendance zones or neighborhood boundaries. Geofencing in a security strategy model provides security to wireless local area networks. This is done by using predefined borders, e.g., an office space with borders established by positioning technology attached to a specially programmed server. The office space becomes an authorized location for designated users and wireless mobile devices. Geo-Fencing uses the Global Positioning System (GPS). Developing Language is Java and the project will develop under the ANDROID platform using eclipse tool.
